title: How McDonald's Really Makes Money (It's Not Burgers)
description:
McDonald's customers spent about $139 billion in 2025 — but the company earns more from rent than from royalties. In this file we open the money machine behind McDonald's: the 1948 Speedee Service System, Ray Kroc's franchising, Harry Sonneborn's real estate model, the 2025 numbers, what franchisees pay, and the loyalty app.

{CHAPTERS}

Sources: McDonald's Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2025 results release; McDonald's 2025 Form 10-K (SEC); McDonald's corporate history page; McDonald's Canada franchising financials page; History.com; Wikipedia (Ray Kroc, Harry J. Sonneborn).

All figures are from company reports where available and are rounded. This video is for education only, not investment advice.
